Action_Taken: Dataset Selection Analysis for Public Alternatives

Selected_Dataset.Name: MTSamples
Selected_Dataset.Reason: It provides actual unstructured clinical notes (discharge summaries, H&P, consults), allowing accurate prototyping of tokenizer/pooling strategies that will transfer perfectly to MIMIC once authorized. It avoids the polished prose of PubMed literature.

Client_Simulation_Strategy.Clinical_Modality: Partition MTSamples by Medical Specialty to simulate specialized hospital wards.
Client_Simulation_Strategy.IoT_Modality: Partition Edge-IIoT canonical flows by Attack Type or Subnet to simulate distinct network threat landscapes.
Client_Simulation_Strategy.Alignment: No fake patient-to-device mappings. Modalities are aggregated at the model-weight level via FedAvg.
